question: Can changing the pre-run remainder pair on both signal channels give an open outlet and a complete quiet outlet under the same probe and fixed tensor?
claim_scope: Prepared state-dependent transfer/blocking. Not an autonomously written router, a new K preference claim, or path erasure.
motivation: The prior frozen K test failed because channel14 still transmitted when only channel0 memory varied. Preserve that failure and test a new paired preparation.

geometry.arms: Six sites per arm, origin+/- (j,0,0), j=1..6.
geometry.variable_sites: At indices2 and3 on each arm, replace both remainders with the declared pair; countersremainzero.
geometry.outlets: Nodes origin+(-6,0,0) and origin+(6,0,0), all48 channels.

preparations.probe_location: Origin; total initial counter L1=2, all apparatus counterszero.
preparations.isolated_runs: Each side(-1,+1) times each variant(O,N,R), sourcepresent; replace every channel of the other arm with background.
preparations.isolation_no_source_baseline: All zero-counter isolated apparatuses are exactly stationary by Rule3 for arbitrary valid remainder fields. Use this proved exact baseline; no extra executed runs are claimed.

observers.counter_transmission: Any nonzero probe-induced b counter at a declared outlet over the full window; report all signed b and a values, not just a convenient channel.
observers.weak_block: All48 outlet b counters equal the matching no-source baseline at every sample6..40.
observers.strong_block: All48 complete(a,b,r) triples at the outlet equal the corresponding no-source control at every sample6..40.
observers.first_leak: First nonzero difference in any outlet component, including remainder-only differences; retain exact step/channel/component.
observers.no_erasure: Retain complete board states and inverse audits, including off-axis influences and all remainder halos.

acceptance.nominal_isolated: For both directions, isolated O transmits and isolated N has strong complete-outlet block throughout6..40.
acceptance.nominal_composition: In joint O/N and N/O runs, the O outlet transmits and the N outlet has strong complete-outlet block throughout6..40; every corresponding no-source run is stationary.
acceptance.overall: Both nominal isolated and nominal composition criteria hold. Reverse variant R is a prespecified control, not a substitute accepted after a failed N result.
acceptance.weak_only: If only b is quiet but any a/r differs, report counter-only blocking and fail the strong block criterion.
acceptance.no_score_redefinition: No K reranking or new complexity metric is used to accept this transfer experiment.

cancellation.additional_requirements: Only report a cancellation comparison if an outlet active under its matching isolated-arm probe becomes completely quiet in the joint run during the same fixedwindow, with a same-channel/update witness: joint old(a,b)=0, netu=0, sum(abs(six signed inputs))>0, isolatednetu!=0 and isolatednextb!=0. Retain both input vectors and updates.
cancellation.nominal_neutral_block: A neutral outlet already quiet in isolation is a prepared blocker, not cancellation by a competitor.

structural_diagnostic.optional_exact_invariant: For central partner Jg=-g, check a_J=-a_g, b_J=-b_g, r_J=4-r_g on all even-parity pairs if supported by the independent algebra implementation. Report it separately; it does not replace the all48-output criterion.

budget.exhaustion: Inconclusive; retain completed prefix and stop reason.

interpretation.positive: A finite prepared open/block interface with all-channel readouts and symmetric placement controls; still needs incoming-signal writing of its memory and new-size/longer-horizon confirmation before a reusable router claim.
interpretation.negative: Counterexample to this paired-preparation interface within the declared horizon, not a global impossibility proof.
interpretation.old_cooperation_prediction_status: Remains refuted in its original54-run study.
